opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: Search GitHub for a given username, open their profile and top repo to collect follower count, top repo stars/language and latest post, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com with subject 'Lead for <role>: <username>' and a summary body.
steps: Open github.com and click the Search box
Type the username and run the search
Switch to the Users results filter
Note follower count, top pinned repo (stars, language) and latest post/activity
Optionally open the top repository to confirm stars
Open the New message compose form
Enter body '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post title>.'

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person bio + Wayback Machine historical homepage note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia for their birth date and role, look at a related organization's homepage on the Wayback Machine for a given year, then add a note combining the two facts.
steps: Open Wikipedia and search for the person's name
Open the article and note birth date and main role
Enter the organization's domain and search
Pick the target year on the calendar timeline
Open a snapshot from that year and note the headline
Open the Notes app and click New note
